variants.notes: The template docx has exactly ONE repeatable fee-table row - not capped at any fixed count. Supply a `components` list with one entry per REAL component the user described (2, 3, 5, however many); DocTemplateEngine clones the template row once per entry and discards the original. Each entry has `label` (a short name for the component, e.g. 'שלב הגשת התביעה') and `terms` (ONE free-text line fully composed by the AI from what the user actually said). `example_terms` above are PATTERNS (matching real fee-proposal letters reviewed 2026-09-12: staged/milestone fees, contingency percentages, hourly rates with an hour cap, cost-share splits, non-Client payers) to guide phrasing/structure when a component matches one of these common shapes - fill in the {{...}} slots in whichever pattern fits from what the user described, keeping the surrounding wording. They are illustrative, not exhaustive and not a closed enum: a genuinely different arrangement the user describes should be composed as its own free-text line in the same natural, contract-appropriate register, not forced into the nearest example if it doesn't actually fit. Either way, `terms` is not restricted to a fixed sub-shape (no separate rigid amount/percentage/payer fields) - but every fact inside it, whether following an example pattern or freely composed, must come from the conversation, never invented. Never pad the `components` list with an invented entry to hit some expected count, and never merge two real components into one to reduce the count - REQ-083-02 forbids inventing OR collapsing data either way, and applies with equal force to inventing/omitting a detail WITHIN one component's `terms` line. TOTAL_FEE is ONE complete phrase (amount + ₪ + VAT status, e.g. '15,000 ₪ כולל מע"מ') composed from what the user said - the template no longer appends its own fixed currency/VAT text.

שכר טרחה לפי מתכונת שלבים: {{STAGE_1_LABEL}} - {{STAGE_1_AMOUNT}} ₪, {{STAGE_2_LABEL}} - {{STAGE_2_AMOUNT}} ₪, וכן הלאה, כפי שנמסר על ידי הלקוח.

selection_cues: the client is offered a CHOICE between two or more mutually-exclusive fee structures for the SAME engagement (e.g. a flat fee track vs. a lower base fee + contingency percentage track) - the client picks exactly ONE, never both
distinct from multi_component_agreement: there, every component applies together; here, each track is a full standalone alternative and only one is ever actually charged
language like 'שני מסלולים', 'לבחירת הלקוח', 'מסלול א/מסלול ב', 'either you can pay X or Y'
an add-on/extra clause that applies regardless of which track the client picks (e.g. a fee for a specific extra appearance/step) belongs in SHARED_ADDON_TERMS, not inside any one track
הסכם עם שני מסלולי שכר טרחה חלופיים לבחירת הלקוח
variants.notes: The template docx has exactly ONE repeatable 'track' block (a heading + one free-text paragraph) - supports any N >= 2 tracks, same clone-and-discard mechanism as multi_component_agreement's row, applied at the track level instead of the component level. Supply a `components` list (reusing the same tool-call field name as multi_component_agreement for consistency) with one entry per real track: `label` is the track's short name (e.g. 'מסלול א'\' - שכר טרחה קבוע'), `terms` is ONE free-text passage - which MAY itself describe multiple sub-items within that track (e.g. 'מסלול זה כולל: (1) ... (2) ...') - fully composed by the AI from what the user actually described for that specific track, never invented or borrowed from another track. `SHARED_ADDON_TERMS` is a required scalar placeholder for any add-on that applies regardless of which track is chosen; if the user described no such shared add-on, state that explicitly (e.g. 'אין תוספות החלות על שני המסלולים') rather than omitting the placeholder or inventing one. Never pad to a round number of tracks, never merge two genuinely distinct tracks into one, and never invent a track the user did not actually offer as an alternative - same REQ-083-02 discipline as multi_component_agreement's components.
